rules.statement: An action for pecuniary loss suffered by the dependants of a person killed by the negligent act of a defendant is barred after two years from the date of death, as governed by section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: 'No action shall be maintainable for any loss, injury, or damage, unless the same shall be commenced within two years from the time when the cause of action shall have arisen.'
